theBarIsCarriedTheInstrumentIsNot.bar: 0.02 deviation ratio, carried from criterion 19 and enforced by src/release/multi-lod-assembly.ts.
theBarIsCarriedTheInstrumentIsNot.frozenInstrument: scripts/blender/block835_v3_author.py::measure_silhouette — Blender, ORTHOGRAPHIC, four axis-aligned horizontal views, the subject ISOLATED via hide_render on every other mesh, ortho_scale derived from the subject's own bounds so it fills the frame.
theBarIsCarriedTheInstrumentIsNot.thisInstrument: CesiumJS in the shipped app — PERSPECTIVE, NO isolation available, magnification pinned by the 400 m cell ring.
theBarIsCarriedTheInstrumentIsNot.statement: THESE ARE DIFFERENT INSTRUMENTS. No part of T006 may present this one as the instrument criterion 19 was written against. Only the BAR is carried.
theBarIsCarriedTheInstrumentIsNot.repositoryPrecedent: src/release/midtown-core-v3-silhouette.ts abandoned rasterization for an exact integer sweep because 'a 512-pixel raster's own quantization is the same order as the ratios being compared against a 2% cap' — and that was an ORTHO view with the subject FILLING the frame.

vehicle.cesiumFovAxis: horizontal when width > height (CesiumJS PerspectiveFrustum default)

terms.t1BoundaryQuantization: perimeterPixels x 1px / areaPixels — a mask is a threshold over an antialiased render.

t2RingScaleDelta.statement: 1 - (399/401)^2. The level flips when the CELL crosses 400 m, so the arms cannot share a camera. IRREDUCIBLE without a forced-LOD hook, and IDENTICAL for every building — it alone spends half the bar.

terms.t3Registration: perimeterPixels x 0.5px / areaPixels — sub-pixel residual after centroid alignment.
terms.t4Isolation: UNBOUNDED, and deliberately not given a number. The frozen instrument isolates with hide_render; the shipped renderer has no equivalent, neighbours overlap the target in perspective, and the whole CELL flips together so the occluders differ between arms. Supplying isolation would be a runtime change, which this task may not make.
terms.direction: The emitted total is T1+T2+T3: it OMITS T4 and computes T1/T3 from the bounding rectangle, which overstates area and so understates the ratio. This is an OPTIMISTIC LOWER BOUND on the instrument's error.

resolutionThreshold.boundaryTermAloneStatement: T1 ALONE would clear 0.02 at 40000 device px^2. This figure is NOT the operative one and must not be quoted as if it were.
resolutionThreshold.operativeStatement: THE OPERATIVE THRESHOLD. With T2 spending 0.995% of the bar before any pixel is counted, and T3 riding the same perimeter as T1, a compact target needs about 356440 device px^2 — roughly a 597x597 px box.
resolutionThreshold.pixelsPerMetreBasis: 4.3627 device px per metre AT THE NEAR ARM (399 m), which is the distance the budget is computed at; at the ring itself (400 m) it is 4.3518.
resolutionThreshold.atTheRing: That is a projected 18727 m^2 — e.g. 137 m wide by 137 m tall.

viewportScaling.note: Could a bigger render target rescue it? Both axes are scaled so the aspect -- and therefore the derived vertical FOV -- stays fixed and resolution actually moves. It does move: the 1x honest stop stands, but the render-target-resolution axis is a real successor path, and any subset it rescues is selected by SIZE and is therefore a biased stratum, not the census.

verdict.overall: HONEST-STOP: the measurement half of T006 cannot be run at this bar with this instrument.
verdict.statement: Pre-registered BEFORE any capture. Per the adjudicated Stage 0 rule, a budget exceeding the bar for all realistic strata makes T006's measurement half one honest stop, and the task proceeds to the census and shed-tone deliverables.
